title: Google Stock (GOOGL) Falls 12.6% After Q3 Earnings Report (Oct 29)
summary: GOOGL fell 12.64% to $283.82 on Oct 29 after Alphabet's Q3 results, as a search revenue miss and $51.4 billion in AI spending weighed on Google stock.
body_markdown:
Large tech peers were mixed.[Microsoft (MSFT)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/msft/) edged down 0.16%,[Amazon (AMZN)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/amzn/) fell 4.25% and[Meta Platforms (META)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/meta/) gained 1.96%.


## Why Google Stock Fell


Alphabet published its results on Wednesday, October 28, with its earnings call set for 4:30 p.m. ET, after the market closed, so Thursday was the first regular session to trade on them. According to[the company's official release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001652044/000165204426000080/googexhibit991q32026.htm) , revenue rose 25% to $127.6 billion, Google Services revenue rose 11% to $96.3 billion and Google Cloud revenue grew 103% to $30.7 billion.


As reported by[The Wall Street Journal](https://finance.yahoo.com/m/7de736d5-8f05-3702-a25c-775cc4a35629/stocks-to-watch-recap%3A.html) , Alphabet missed analysts' expectations on revenue from its core business unit that includes search advertising, and the stock's fall eclipsed its previous largest one-day loss of 11.6% in 2020.


Per CNN Business, investors also weighed slowing growth in search advertising against a continued ramp-up in AI spending. Capital expenditures reached $51.4 billion in the quarter, and Alphabet disclosed a second consecutive quarter of negative free cash flow, which the release puts at negative $9.1 billion. CNN Business contrasted this with Microsoft, which reported $18.6 billion in third-quarter free cash flow in[its own quarterly results](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/microsoft-cloud-beat-backs-rebound-lower-capex-hits-coreweave-and-neocloud-stocks-msft-crwv/) .


The[earnings report](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/how-to-read-an-earnings-report/) also showed net income falling to $26.5 billion from $35.0 billion and diluted earnings per share falling to $2.12 from $2.87. The release attributes part of that decline to an $8.7 billion loss on equity securities, which cut diluted earnings per share by $0.55.


## GOOGL Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Google Cloud revenue more than doubled to $30.7 billion, and the company said TPU system sales were a meaningful contributor.
- Operating income rose 30% to $40.6 billion for a 31.8% operating margin, and CEO Sundar Pichai said Alphabet is "now on a half-trillion dollar revenue run rate."
- Google Search and other revenue grew 12% to $63.4 billion, and Pichai said year-over-year query growth is "the highest it's been in the last five years," as reported by[Verdict](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/google-owner-alphabet-reports-25-222600571.html) .


### Risks


- Quarterly capital expenditures of $51.4 billion left free cash flow negative at $9.1 billion, according to the company's release.
- CNN Business reported renewed concern that users are turning to AI chatbots instead of traditional search, and Jed Ellerbroek of Argent Capital Management said the shift could happen "faster than Google can react to it and pivot their business."
- Revenue from the unit that includes search advertising came in below analysts' expectations, per The Wall Street Journal.
